cohort: 5560 women who delivered at the Gyane Unit-1 SZWH, SMBBMU, Larkana from April 1, 2017 to April 30, 2018.
finding: The study found a 4.46% incidence of intrauterine fetal death, with post-term pregnancy, placental abruption, obesity, advanced maternal age, hypertension, diabetes, PPROM, multiparity, and smoking identified as associated risk factors.
